meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate AI images using FAL AI (Seedream 4, Flux 2), Gemini, OpenAI, or Grok (xAI). Use for blog covers, newsfeed visuals, marketing content, cinematic keyframes, or any image generation needs. Seedream 4 is the default for cinematic/creative marketing work — it beats Flux 2 on composition, photorealism, and scene complexity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作博客封面、社媒配图与电影级营销素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要为文章、社媒或广告配视觉素材。
copy.tagline_en: Create blog covers, social visuals, and cinematic marketing imagery with AI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need visuals for articles, social posts, or ads.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把图片生成需求转成脚本调用，从 FAL AI、Gemini、OpenAI 或 Grok 生成图片，默认保存为 WebP（常见 16:9），放到 packages/marketing/public/images/，并可直接作为博客封面引用。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成或替换博客封面、推送配图、营销素材等图片时触发；也用于抽象概念的视觉隐喻或社交配图。

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张科技感封面图，16:9。
say.note: 会调用默认模型并生成 WebP 图片。

say.text: 把‘咖啡机工作原理’做成信息图，带清晰标签。
say.note: 会用说明性插画风格出图。

say.text: 生成 4 个咖啡店 Logo 变体，方形，扁平风。
say.note: 会按变体数量一次性生成多张。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns image requests into script calls using FAL AI, Gemini, OpenAI, or Grok. Output: WebP, usually 16:9, saved to packages/marketing/public/images/, usable in blog frontmatter.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or replace blog covers, feed visuals, marketing assets, social images, or similar AI image generation tasks.

say_en.text: Generate a tech-feel cover image for this article, 16:9.
say_en.note: Uses the default model and saves a WebP.

say_en.text: Make an infographic of how a coffee machine works, with clear labels.
Create 4 logo variations for a coffee shop, square, flat design.
say_en.note: Generates multiple variants in one run.
